past_paper_mcqs.stem_text:
If a body of mass $10\text{ kg}$ is placed on the surface of the Earth, then the pull of the Earth on the body will be
(Note: The value of acceleration due to gravity is $9.8\text{ m/s}^2$.)
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: The pull of Earth on a body is its weight $W = mg = 10\text{ kg} \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2 = 98\text{ N}$.

past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: Two forces ($9\text{ N}$ and $12\text{ N}$) act at the right angle at point O, as shown in the given figure. What will be the magnitude and direction of the resultant force?
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: Magnitude $R = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{81 + 144} = \sqrt{225} = 15\text{ N}$. By vector addition (head-to-tail / parallelogram law), the resultant lies along OQ.

past_paper_mcqs.stem_text: A sports racing car is made stable by
options: D. lowering its centre of gravity.
past_paper_mcqs.explanation: Lowering the centre of gravity increases stability, preventing the car from tipping over during sharp turns.
